Quest name: Winds of a Champion
Quest location: Venice Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r13 Ecological Research, r15 Biology, ARA(Arabic)
Pre-requisite discovery: Lion discovery (from "King of the beasts" quest) + Atlas Mountains discovery (from "Titans Range" quest)
Additional note: "Branch-off" part of Xanadu/Great Adventurer questchain
